## Defining Themes & Color Palettes

```{r constants}

# Libraries ======
library(ggplot2)
#=================

# Read in themes & functions
source('functions_visualization.R')

# Used for all visualizations
colo_pale <- c(
  '#335c67',
  '#fff3b0',
  '#e09f3e',
  '#9e2a2b',
  '#540b0e',
  "#C4775A",
  "#C99488",
  "#8FA694",
  "#A6A078",
  "#D2AA69",
  "#E2CFB0",
  "#76594A",
  "#719D99",
  "#F0E9DC"
)

diag_x = theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

## Reading in & Prepping Data

```{r read_prep}

train_data_raw <- read.csv('../../data/final_test_train/stop_search_train_imputed.csv')
# Prep data
# Factorize all non-continuous measures
cont_variables <- c(
  "VehicleYear", "SubjectAge", "SubjectHeight",
  "SubjectWeight", "Longitude", "Latitude", "hour"
)
train_data <- train_data_raw |>
  # Turn all variables into factors
  mutate(across(everything(), as.factor)) |>
  
  # Turn the appropriate variables into continuous measures
  mutate(across(
    all_of(cont_variables),
    as.numeric
  )) |>
  
  # Remove relevant variables (see 10/13 documentation for justification)
  select(-where(~ is.factor(.) & n_distinct(.) > 10),
         -Longitude, # Remove these variables
         -Latitude) |>
    
  mutate(
    search_occurred_fct = factor(
      if_else(
        search_occurred == 1,
        "Searched",
        "Unsearched"
      ),
      levels = c("Unsearched", "Searched")
    )
  )

```

### Relabeling Data

```{r relab}

train_data <- train_data |>
  mutate(
    SubjectRace = if_else(
      SubjectRace == "NATIVE HAWAIIAN OR OTHER PACIFIC ISLANDER",
      "NHPI",
      SubjectRace
    ),
    
    night_fct = if_else(
      night == '0',
      "Daytime",
      "Nighttime"
    ),
    
    age_group = factor(case_when(
      SubjectAge < 18 ~ 'Under 18',
      SubjectAge %in% 18:24 ~ '18-24',
      SubjectAge %in% 25:34 ~ '25-34',
      SubjectAge %in% 35:44 ~ '35-44',
      SubjectAge %in% 45:54 ~ '45-54',
      SubjectAge >= 55 ~ '55+',
    ))
    
    )

```


## Category 1: Driver Characteristics

```{r driver_race}

# 1) Race & Searches --------------
ggplot(train_data |>
         sort_bars("SubjectRace", decreasing = TRUE),
       aes(x = SubjectRace, fill = SubjectRace)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Racial Makeup of Stops"
  ) +
  eda_fill("SubjectRace", train_data) +
  theme_eda() +
  diag_x

# Summarize by response
ggplot(summarize_binary(train_data, SubjectRace) |>
  sort_bars(
    "SubjectRace",
    by = "Searched",
    response = "search_occurred_fct",
    decreasing = FALSE
  ),
       aes(x = SubjectRace, y = freq, fill = search_occurred_fct)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  labs(
    x = "Identified Race of Subject",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Search occurred",
    title = "Search Distribution Among Racial Groups"
  ) +
  eda_fill("SubjectRace", train_data) +
  theme_eda()

```

```{r driver_features}


# 2) Hair Color --------------
train_data |>
  mutate(EyeHair = interaction(SubjectHairColor, SubjectEyeColor)) |>
  sort_bars("EyeHair", decreasing = TRUE) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = EyeHair, fill = SubjectHairColor)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    x = "Hair and Eye Color",
    title = "Top 8 Combinations of Hair & Eye Color"
  ) +
  eda_fill("SubjectHairColor", train_data) +
  theme_eda() +
  diag_x + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1, 8))

```

```{r driver_height_weight}

# 3) Driver height weight -------
ggplot(train_data,
       aes(x = SubjectHeight, y = SubjectWeight, color = search_occurred_fct)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Driver Height by Driver Weight",
    x = "Driver Height (in)",
    y = "Driver Weight (lb)",
    caption = "Plots highlighted by search occurrence"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Unsearched" = colo_pale[2], "Searched" = colo_pale[1])) +
  theme_eda()

```

```{r driver_age}

ggplot(train_data |>
         sort_bars("age_group", decreasing = TRUE),
       aes(x = age_group, fill = search_occurred_fct)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Age Makeup of Stops & Searches",
    x = "Age Group"
  ) +
  eda_fill("search_occurred", train_data) +
  theme_eda()

```

## Nighttime Discrimination Detail

```{r}

# Day 
day_train <- train_data |>
  filter(night == "1")
# Night
night_train <- train_data |>
  filter(night == "0")

# 1) Race --------------
ggplot(summarize_binary(day_train, SubjectRace) |>
  sort_bars(
    "SubjectRace",
    by = "Searched",
    response = "search_occurred_fct",
    decreasing = FALSE
  ),
       aes(x = SubjectRace, y = log(freq), fill = search_occurred_fct)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  labs(
    x = "Identified Race",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Search occurred",
    title = "Scaled Race Distribution Among Day Stops"
  ) +
  eda_fill("SubjectRace", train_data) +
  theme_eda()

ggplot(summarize_binary(night_train, SubjectRace) |>
  sort_bars(
    "SubjectRace",
    by = "Searched",
    response = "search_occurred_fct",
    decreasing = FALSE
  ),
       aes(x = SubjectRace, y = log(freq), fill = search_occurred_fct)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  labs(
    x = "Identified Race",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Search occurred",
    title = "Scaled Race Distribution Among Night Stops"
  ) +
  eda_fill("SubjectRace", train_data) +
  theme_eda() +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1))

```
